title: What Is Lion’s Mane and Why Is It Popular?

# What Is Lion’s Mane? Benefits, Uses, and What to Know  
**Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus)** is a functional mushroom recognized for its shaggy, white appearance and its supportive role in cognitive clarity, gut–brain harmony, and immune balance. Historically used in Asian wellness traditions, Lion’s Mane is now popular worldwide thanks to its unique compounds—such as **hericenones**, **beta-glucans**, and **polysaccharides**—that help support the body’s natural systems.  
For those interested, [QNL offers Lion’s Mane Quantum](https://qnlabs.com/lion-s-mane-quantum.html), a full-spectrum fruiting body extract, available for purchase.
### What part of Lion’s Mane is best?  
The **fruiting body** typically contains higher levels of hericenones and beta-glucans compared with grain-grown mycelium.
